entries.body: Alakazam outspeeds almost every story opponent and its huge Sp. Atk ends most fights in one hit. Abra shows up early on Routes 24, 25 and 5 to 8 but teleports away, so lead with a sleep move. Kadabra evolves by trade, but Kadabra alone is already strong.

Gengar is fast with high Sp. Atk, and its Ghost typing makes it immune to Normal and Fighting moves. Gastly haunts Pokémon Tower, and Haunter evolves by trade, though Haunter is a fine stand-in until then. It is weak to Psychic and Ground, so be careful around Sabrina and Giovanni.

Machamp has some of the highest Attack in the game, and Fighting moves hit Normal, Rock, Ice, Steel and Dark types super effectively. Machop lives in Rock Tunnel and evolves into Machoke at 28. Machamp needs a trade, but Machoke is strong on its own.

Golem's Rock/Ground typing makes it immune to Electric moves and gives it huge Defense, so it walls Lt. Surge and threatens Blaine's Fire types. Geodude is everywhere in early caves like Mt. Moon and Rock Tunnel, and Graveler evolves by trade. It is 4× weak to Water and Grass, so switch out against those.

Magikarp is in nearly every body of water and evolves into Gyarados at level 20, so you can have it very early. Intimidate weakens physical attackers as it switches in, and its high Attack makes it a threat all game. It is 4× weak to Electric, so keep it away from Electric gyms.

Arcanine has great stats across the board, and Intimidate helps it stay in long fights. Growlithe appears on Routes 5 to 8 and in the Pokémon Mansion, and a Fire Stone evolves it. It beats Erika's Grass types and is a solid answer to Bug, Ice and Steel teams later.

Raichu is quick and its Electric moves handle Misty's Water types and the many Water and Flying trainers in Kanto. Pikachu lives in Viridian Forest and the Power Plant, and a Thunderstone evolves it. It is frail on defense, so let it strike first.

Nidoking learns attacks of many types, so one Pokémon can cover most gym matchups. Nidoran♂ is on Kanto's early routes, evolves at 16, and a Moon Stone turns Nidorino into Nidoking. Its Ground typing makes it immune to Electric moves, which helps against Lt. Surge.

Nidoqueen is bulkier than Nidoking and has a similarly wide movepool, so it can take hits while covering many types. Nidoran♀ is on Kanto's early routes, evolves at 16, and a Moon Stone turns Nidorina into Nidoqueen. Like Nidoking, its Ground typing makes it immune to Electric moves.

Dugtrio is one of the fastest Pokémon you can get early, and Ground moves crush Lt. Surge's Electric types and Blaine's Fire types. Diglett lives in Diglett's Cave near Vermilion and evolves at 26. It is frail, so use it to strike first rather than to take hits.

Starmie is fast with high Sp. Atk, and it pairs Water and Psychic moves with wide TM coverage. Staryu can be fished up around Kanto's coasts, such as Cerulean City and Routes 19 to 21, and a Water Stone evolves it. It handles Brock, Blaine and Giovanni well and stays useful through the Elite Four.

Lapras has huge HP and gets both Water and Ice moves, which makes it one of the best answers to Lance's Dragon types. It lives in Icefall Cave in Kanto, Johto's Safari Zone and Sinnoh's Victory Road. It is slow, so it wins by taking a hit and hitting back.

Dragonite has excellent stats in every area, and its biggest weakness is Ice, which hits it 4×. Dratini can be fished in Kanto's Safari Zone, Johto's Dragon's Den and Sinnoh's Mt. Coronet. It only becomes Dragonite at level 55, so it pays off late in the story.

Vileplume hits Misty's and Giovanni's teams with strong Grass moves and can put foes to sleep with Sleep Powder. Oddish is common on Kanto's routes and evolves at 21, then a Leaf Stone turns Gloom into Vileplume. It is slow, so let it take a hit before it fires back.

Magneton's Electric/Steel typing resists a long list of attack types, and its Sp. Atk is high for a mid-game Pokémon. Magnemite appears in the Power Plant and on Route 6 and evolves at 30. It is 4× weak to Ground, so avoid Giovanni, and it can later evolve into Magnezone at a special location.

Rhydon hits hard and takes physical hits well, and its Rock/Ground typing blanks Electric moves and beats Fire types. Rhyhorn lives in Rock Tunnel and the Safari Zone, but it only evolves at 42. It is 4× weak to Water and Grass, so it struggles against Misty, Erika and Lorelei.

Poliwrath combines Water and Fighting attacks, which covers Rock, Ground, Fire, Ice and Normal types in one Pokémon. Poliwag is common in Kanto's water and evolves at 25, then a Water Stone makes Poliwrath. Its good bulk lets it take hits while it does that.

Cloyster's Defense is among the highest in the game, so physical attackers barely dent it, and its Ice moves handle Dragon and Flying types. Shellder can be fished along Kanto's coasts and a Water Stone evolves it at any time. Its Sp. Def is low, so keep it away from strong special attackers.

Vaporeon has very high HP and good Sp. Atk, so it wins long fights against Rock, Ground and Fire types. Eevee is a rare spawn on Kanto's Route 17, and a Water Stone evolves it. Water Absorb also makes it immune to Water moves.

Houndoom's Fire and Dark attacks cover Grass, Bug, Ice, Steel, Psychic and Ghost types. Houndour appears on Kanto's Route 7 and Sinnoh's Route 214, and it evolves at 24. It is frail on the physical side, so it does best when it strikes first.

Kangaskhan has solid HP, Attack and Speed, and Scrappy lets its Normal moves hit Ghost types. It lives in the Safari Zones of Kanto and Johto, so it takes some patience to catch. It has no evolution, so it is ready to use the moment you catch it.

Heracross's Bug and Fighting moves cover Normal, Rock, Ice, Dark, Grass and Psychic types, and its Attack is very high. In Johto you can find it early by using Headbutt on trees around Azalea Town, and it also comes from Honey Trees in Sinnoh. Flying moves hit it 4×, so watch out for Falkner and Winona.

Donphan has high Attack and Defense, and its Ground typing blanks Electric moves. Phanpy appears early on Routes 45 and 46 and evolves at 25. It is slow, so it fights by taking a hit and hitting back.

Tauros is fast with high Attack and needs no evolving, so it is strong the moment you catch it. It roams Routes 38 and 39 in Johto and Kanto's Safari Zone. Intimidate softens physical attackers when it switches in.

Miltank has high Defense and Speed, and Milk Drink lets it heal in the middle of long fights. It lives on Routes 38 and 39 near Olivine City, alongside Tauros. Thick Fat also halves Fire and Ice damage.

Ampharos has high Sp. Atk and good bulk, which is enough to handle the many Water and Flying types in Johto. Mareep is on Route 32 near the start and evolves at 15 and 30. It is slow, so it wins by trading hits.

Exeggutor has high Sp. Atk and two attacking types that handle Water, Ground, Rock, Fighting and Poison types. Exeggcute falls out of Headbutt trees from the very first Johto routes, and a Leaf Stone evolves it. It is slow and 4× weak to Bug, so keep it away from Bug-heavy trainers.

Quagsire's Water/Ground typing leaves Grass as its only weakness and makes it immune to Electric moves. Wooper appears on Route 32 and in Union Cave and evolves at 20. It is slow but bulky, and it handles Electric, Fire, Rock and Poison types.

Ursaring has very high Attack, and Guts boosts it further when it is poisoned, burned or paralyzed. Teddiursa lives in Dark Cave and on Route 45 and evolves at 30. Watch out for Chuck's and Bruno's Fighting types.

Lanturn's typing means only Grass and Ground hit it super effectively, and it has Electric moves for the Water and Flying types that are everywhere. Chinchou can be fished around New Bark Town and Routes 26 and 27 and evolves at 27. Its high HP lets it take hits well.

Slowbro has high HP and Defense, and its Water and Psychic moves cover Fire, Rock, Ground, Fighting and Poison types. Slowpoke lives in Slowpoke Well near Azalea Town, so you can catch it before the second gym, and it evolves at 37. It is very slow, so it wins by outlasting rather than outspeeding.

Granbull has high Attack and Intimidate, which makes it a dependable physical attacker in Johto. Snubbull appears on Routes 34 and 35 near Goldenrod City and evolves at 23. It is slow, so it leans on Intimidate and bulk rather than speed.

Forretress has very high Defense, and its Bug/Steel typing resists many attack types, with Fire as its only weakness. Pineco falls out of Headbutt trees all over Johto and evolves at 31. It hits weakly, so use it as a tank rather than your main attacker.

Xatu is fast, and its Psychic and Flying moves handle Fighting, Poison, Grass and Bug types, which makes Chuck and Koga easier. Natu falls out of Headbutt trees around Violet City, Ecruteak City and the National Park and evolves at 25. Its bulk is low, so send it into matchups it clearly wins.

Kingdra's Water/Dragon typing is only weak to Dragon, and it has balanced stats on both sides. Horsea lives in Whirl Islands and Dragon's Den and evolves into Seadra at 32. Seadra needs a trade holding a Dragon Scale, but Seadra is useful until then.

A Marill with Huge Power grows into an Azumarill that hits much harder than its stats suggest, and you can catch Marill as early as Route 102. It evolves at 18, so it is ready for the early gyms. Check the ability before you train it, because Thick Fat Marill lose most of the appeal.

Breloom has very high Attack and learns Mach Punch when it evolves, and its Grass and Fighting moves handle Roxanne, Norman and Juan. Shroomish lives in Petalburg Woods near the start and evolves at 23. Flying moves hit it 4×, so be careful against Winona.

Gardevoir has high Sp. Atk and Sp. Def, and its Psychic moves handle Fighting and Poison types. Ralts is a rare find on Hoenn's Route 102 and Sinnoh's Routes 208 and 209, and it evolves at 20 and 30. Ralts and Kirlia are fragile, so they need careful training early on.

Swellow is one of the fastest early Pokémon, and Guts makes it hit even harder when it is statused. Taillow lives in Petalburg Woods and on Route 104 and evolves at 22. Its Flying moves beat Brawly's Fighting types and many Grass and Bug types.

Ludicolo's Water/Grass typing takes neutral damage from Fire, Ice and Electric, and only Flying, Poison and Bug moves hit it super effectively. Lotad is easy to find around Route 102 and evolves into Lombre at 14, then a Water Stone gives Ludicolo. It is a strong answer to Juan, Wallace and the Ground and Rock types in Hoenn.

Hariyama has huge HP and high Attack, and Thick Fat or Guts makes it hard to wear down. Makuhita lives in Granite Cave near Dewford Town and evolves at 24. Its Fighting moves beat Norman's Normal types and Glacia's Ice types.

Aggron's Defense is enormous, so physical attackers barely scratch it, and its Rock and Steel moves handle Flying and Ice types. Aron lives in Granite Cave and evolves at 32 and 42. It is 4× weak to Fighting and Ground, so keep it away from Brawly.

Manectric is fast with high Sp. Atk, and its Electric moves handle Winona's Flying types and the Water types of Juan and Wallace. Electrike appears on Route 110 and evolves at 26. It is frail, so it works best when it moves first.

Camerupt's Ground typing makes it immune to Electric moves, and its Fire and Ground attacks handle Flannery, the Steel types in Hoenn and Electric users. Numel lives along the Fiery Path and Jagged Pass and evolves at 33. It is 4× weak to Water, which is common in Hoenn, so pick its fights.

Flygon is fast with high Attack, and Levitate plus its Ground typing make it immune to both Ground and Electric moves. Trapinch lives in the Route 111 desert and evolves at 35 and 45. Ice moves hit it 4×, so watch out for Glacia.

Altaria has strong Sp. Def and resists Grass, Fire, Water, Fighting and Bug, and Dragon Dance lets it make up for modest offense. Swablu appears on Routes 114 and 115 and evolves at 35. Ice moves hit it 4×, so keep it away from Glacia.

Walrein has big HP, solid special stats and Ice moves, which makes it a strong Hoenn answer to Drake's Dragon types. Spheal lives in Shoal Cave and evolves at 32 and 44. Thick Fat also halves Fire and Ice damage.

Salamence has huge Attack and Sp. Atk plus Intimidate, so it can carry the end of the story. Bagon is a rare find in Meteor Falls and Altering Cave, and it only becomes Salamence at 50. Shelgon is slow and passive, so expect a long training stretch.

Metagross has huge Attack and Defense, and its Steel/Psychic typing resists many attack types. Beldum is a rare find in Meteor Falls and evolves at 20 and 45. Beldum only knows Tackle and Take Down, so lean on Metang once it learns better moves.

Skarmory's Steel/Flying typing resists a long list of attack types and makes it immune to Ground and Poison. It lives on Route 113 in Hoenn and on Routes 45, 47 and 48 in Johto, and it needs no evolving. Its offense is modest, so it shines as a tank rather than a sweeper.

Shiftry has good Attack and Sp. Atk, and its Grass and Dark moves handle Water, Ground, Rock, Psychic and Ghost types. Seedot appears on Routes 102 and 114 and evolves into Nuzleaf at 14, then a Leaf Stone makes Shiftry. It is 4× weak to Bug, so it is shaky against Bug-heavy trainers.

Exploud has good HP and attacks, and Soundproof blocks sound moves like Roar and Hyper Voice. Whismur is common on Route 116 and in Rusturf Tunnel and evolves at 20 and 40. Only Fighting moves hit it super effectively, so it is a safe pick for most fights.

Crawdaunt has high Attack, and its Water and Dark moves handle Psychic, Ghost, Fire, Rock and Ground types. Corphish can be fished on Route 102 and in Petalburg City early and evolves at 30. Its defenses are thin, so it works best when it hits first.

Sharpedo has high Attack and Speed, and its Water and Dark moves cover Fire, Rock, Ground, Psychic and Ghost types. Carvanha is fished on Routes 118 and 119 and evolves at 30. It is very frail, so only send it into fights it can end quickly.

Claydol has strong defenses, and Levitate makes it immune to Ground moves on top of its Electric immunity. Baltoy lives in the Route 111 desert and evolves at 36. It is weak to Water, Grass, Ice, Bug, Ghost and Dark, so it fits best as a wall against Electric, Poison and Fighting types.

Garchomp has high Attack, Speed and HP, and its Dragon and Ground moves hit most of the story hard. Gible lives in Wayward Cave beneath the Cycling Road and evolves at 24 and 48. Ice moves hit it 4×, so be careful around Candice.

Luxray has high Attack, and Intimidate weakens physical attackers as it switches in. Shinx is on Routes 202 and 203 right at the start and evolves at 15 and 30. Its Electric moves handle Crasher Wake's Water types and the many Flying types in Sinnoh.

Staraptor is fast with high Attack and learns Close Combat by level, giving it an answer to Normal, Rock and Steel types. Starly is everywhere on Sinnoh's first routes and evolves at 14 and 34. Staravia and Staraptor have Intimidate, which helps them survive physical hits.

Floatzel is fast with good Attack, and Swift Swim doubles its Speed in rain. Buizel appears on Route 205 near Floaroma Town and evolves at 26. Its Water moves handle Ground, Rock and Fire types, including Bertha and Flint.

Gastrodon's Water/Ground typing leaves Grass as its only weakness and makes it immune to Electric moves, and it has high HP. Shellos is common on Route 205 and along Sinnoh's coasts and evolves at 30. It is a dependable answer to Volkner's Electric types and Flint's Fire types.

Mismagius is fast with good Sp. Atk and Sp. Def, and Levitate plus its Ghost typing make it immune to Ground, Normal and Fighting moves. Misdreavus appears in Eterna Forest and on Route 209, and a Dusk Stone evolves it. It handles Maylene's Fighting types and Lucian's Psychic types well.

Honchkrow has very high Attack and Sp. Atk, and its Dark and Flying moves handle Fantina's Ghost types, Lucian's Psychic types and Grass and Fighting types. Murkrow appears in Eterna Forest and on Route 209, and a Dusk Stone evolves it. It is slow and frail on defense, so use it to finish fights.

Bronzong's Steel/Psychic typing resists many attack types, and its defenses are high on both sides. With Levitate it is only weak to Fire, Ghost and Dark, while Heatproof softens Fire instead. Bronzor lives in Mt. Coronet and on Route 206 and evolves at 33.

Lucario has high Attack and Sp. Atk, and its Fighting and Steel moves cover Normal, Rock, Ice, Dark and Steel types. Riolu appears on Sinnoh's Route 216 and in Unova's Pinwheel Forest, and it evolves with high friendship during the day. Its typing resists many attacks but is weak to Fire, Fighting and Ground.

Drapion's Poison/Dark typing leaves Ground as its only weakness and makes it immune to Psychic moves. Skorupi lives in the Great Marsh and evolves at 40. It handles Fantina's Ghost types and Lucian's Psychic types.

Toxicroak has good Attack and Speed, and its Fighting moves handle Normal, Rock, Steel, Ice and Dark types such as Byron's and Candice's teams. Croagunk lives in the Great Marsh and on Route 212 and evolves at 37. Dry Skin makes it immune to Water moves, but Psychic moves hit it 4×.

Yanmega is fast with high Sp. Atk, and Speed Boost makes it faster every turn. Yanma lives in the Great Marsh and evolves when it levels up knowing AncientPower, which it learns at 33. Its Bug moves handle Psychic and Dark types, but Rock moves hit it 4×.

Mamoswine has huge Attack and HP, and its Ice and Ground moves hit Dragon, Electric, Rock, Steel and Flying types hard. Swinub lives around Lake Acuity and Route 217, and Piloswine evolves when it levels up knowing AncientPower. It is a strong answer to Cynthia's Garchomp, and Mamoswine itself appears in Unova's Dragonspiral Tower.

Scyther is fast with high Attack, and Technician powers up its weaker moves early on. It appears on Sinnoh's Routes 210 and 215 and in Kanto's Safari Zone. It can become Scizor by trading while holding a Metal Coat, but Scyther is strong without it.

Pure Power doubles Medicham's Attack, so it hits much harder than its stats suggest. Meditite lives in Mt. Coronet and Hoenn's Mt. Pyre and evolves at 37. Its Fighting and Psychic moves handle Byron, Candice and Poison types.

Roserade has high Sp. Atk and Speed, and its Grass and Poison moves handle Water, Ground and Rock types. Budew and Roselia are common on Sinnoh's early routes and on Hoenn's Route 117, and a Shiny Stone evolves Roselia. Budew needs high friendship during the day to become Roselia.

Hippowdon has very high HP and Defense, and Sand Stream summons a sandstorm that chips at anything that isn't Rock, Ground or Steel. Hippopotas lives in Maniac Tunnel and on Route 228 and evolves at 34. Its Ground moves handle Volkner's Electric types and Flint's Fire types.

Abomasnow's Snow Warning summons hail, which makes Blizzard always hit, and its Grass and Ice moves cover Ground, Water, Dragon and Flying types. Snover lives on Routes 216 and 217 and around Lake Acuity and evolves at 40. Fire hits it 4×, so keep it away from Flint.

Drifblim has huge HP, and its Ghost/Flying typing makes it immune to Normal, Fighting and Ground moves. Drifloon floats around Valley Windworks early in Sinnoh and evolves at 28. Its defenses are low, so it relies on that HP to take hits.

Excadrill has huge Attack, and its Ground/Steel typing makes it immune to Electric and Poison moves. Drilbur comes from dust clouds in Unova caves such as Wellspring Cave and Chargestone Cave and evolves at 31. Its Ground moves handle Electric, Fire, Rock and Poison types, and Steel moves give it an answer to Brycen's Ice types.

Conkeldurr has huge Attack, and Guts or Sheer Force makes its hits even stronger. Timburr lives in Pinwheel Forest and evolves into Gurdurr at 25; Conkeldurr needs a trade, but Gurdurr is strong until then. Its Fighting moves handle Normal, Rock, Ice, Steel and Dark types, including Brycen and Grimsley.

Krookodile has high Attack and Speed, and Intimidate or Moxie helps it in long fights. Sandile lives in the Desert Resort and evolves at 29 and 40. It is immune to Electric and Psychic moves, so it handles Elesa and Caitlin.

Darmanitan has huge Attack and Sheer Force, which makes its Fire moves hit very hard. Darumaka lives in the Desert Resort and on Route 4 and evolves at 35. It handles Brycen's Ice types and the many Grass, Bug and Steel types in Unova.

Lilligant has good Sp. Atk and Speed, and its Grass moves handle Clay's Ground types and the many Water types in Unova. Petilil lives in Pinwheel Forest and Lostlorn Forest, and a Sun Stone evolves it. It is weak to Fire, Ice, Flying, Bug and Poison, so it needs backup against those.

Scolipede is fast with good Attack and Defense, and its Bug and Poison moves handle Grass and Psychic types. Venipede lives in Pinwheel Forest and Lostlorn Forest and evolves at 22 and 30. It is weak to Fire, Flying, Rock and Psychic, so pick its fights.

Zebstrika is very fast with good Attack, and its Electric moves handle Skyla's Flying types and the Water types in Unova. Blitzle appears early on Route 3 and evolves at 27. Lightning Rod or Motor Drive also makes it immune to Electric moves.

Stoutland is a reliable physical attacker with good bulk, and Herdier and Stoutland get Intimidate. Lillipup is on Route 1 at the start and evolves at 16 and 32. Only Fighting moves hit it super effectively, so it is a safe pick for most fights.

Gigalith has huge Attack and Defense, and Sturdy lets it survive one big hit from full HP. Roggenrola appears early in Wellspring Cave and Pinwheel Forest and evolves into Boldore at 25; Gigalith needs a trade, but Boldore holds up well. Its Rock moves handle Skyla's Flying types and Brycen's Ice types.

Seismitoad's Water/Ground typing leaves Grass as its only weakness and makes it immune to Electric moves. Tympole lives in Pinwheel Forest and evolves at 25 and 36, and Palpitoad already has the same typing. It handles Elesa's Electric types and Clay's Ground types well.

Scrafty has high Defense and Sp. Def, and its Dark and Fighting moves handle Psychic, Ghost, Normal, Rock and Ice types. Scraggy is common in the Desert Resort and on Route 4 and evolves at 39. Its typing also makes it immune to Psychic moves, so it handles Caitlin well.

Cinccino is fast, and Technician boosts its weak multi-hit moves like Tail Slap. Minccino lives on Route 5 and in Cold Storage, and a Shiny Stone evolves it. Only Fighting moves hit it super effectively.

Reuniclus has huge Sp. Atk and HP, and with Magic Guard it takes no damage from poison, burns, weather or recoil. Solosis appears on Routes 5 and 16 and evolves at 32 and 41. Its Psychic moves handle Marshal's Fighting types, but it is slow, so it wins by taking a hit first.

Jellicent has high HP and Sp. Def, and its Water/Ghost typing makes it immune to Normal and Fighting moves. Frillish lives in the water around Driftveil City and Route 4 and evolves at 40. It handles Marshal's Fighting types and many Normal-type trainers.

Galvantula is fast, and Compound Eyes makes Thunder far more accurate. Joltik lives in Chargestone Cave and evolves at 36. Its Electric and Bug moves handle Skyla's Flying types and Caitlin's Psychic types.

Ferrothorn has huge Defense and Sp. Def, and its Grass/Steel typing leaves only Fire (4×) and Fighting as weaknesses. Ferroseed lives in Chargestone Cave and evolves at 40. It is very slow, so use it to tank and chip with Iron Barbs rather than to sweep.

Levitate removes Eelektross's only weakness, Ground, so nothing hits it super effectively. Tynamo lives in Chargestone Cave and evolves at 39, then a Thunderstone makes Eelektross. It has strong Attack and Sp. Atk, so it can use both physical and special moves.

Chandelure has very high Sp. Atk, and its Ghost and Fire moves cover Grass, Bug, Ice, Steel, Psychic and Ghost types. Litwick lives in Celestial Tower and evolves at 41, then a Dusk Stone makes Chandelure. It is immune to Normal and Fighting moves.

Haxorus has huge Attack and good Speed, and Dragon Dance makes it hard to stop once it sets up. Axew lives in Mistralton Cave and the Guidance Chamber and evolves at 38 and 48. Only Ice and Dragon moves hit it super effectively.

Mienshao is fast with high Attack, and its Fighting moves handle Normal, Rock, Ice, Steel and Dark types. Mienfoo lives in Dragonspiral Tower and on Route 14 but only evolves at 50, so Mienfoo carries most of the work. Regenerator heals it every time it switches out.

Braviary has high Attack and HP, and its Flying moves handle Fighting, Grass and Bug types. Rufflet shows up early in the Desert Resort and Pinwheel Forest, but it only evolves at 54. Sheer Force on some Braviary makes moves with side effects hit harder.

Tyranitar has huge Attack and bulk, and Sand Stream whips up a sandstorm that boosts Rock types' Sp. Def. In Unova, Larvitar comes from dust clouds in Twist Mountain, and in Johto it is a rare Safari Zone find; it evolves at 30 and 55. Fighting moves hit it 4×, so watch out for Marshal and Bruno.

Leavanny is fast with good Attack, and its Bug and Grass moves handle Water, Ground, Rock, Psychic and Dark types. Sewaddle lives in Pinwheel Forest and evolves at 20, then Swadloon evolves with high friendship. It is 4× weak to Fire and Flying, so avoid those fights.

Zoroark is fast with high Sp. Atk, and its Dark moves handle Psychic and Ghost types such as Caitlin's and Shauntal's. Zorua appears in hordes in Lostlorn Forest and evolves at 30. Illusion disguises it as the last Pokémon in your party, which can bait foes into the wrong move.

Sawk has high Attack and good Speed, and Sturdy lets it survive one big hit from full HP. It appears early in Pinwheel Forest and needs no evolving. Its Fighting moves handle Normal, Rock, Ice, Steel and Dark types, including Brycen and Grimsley.

Bisharp has high Attack, and its Dark/Steel typing resists many attack types and is immune to Psychic and Poison moves. Pawniard lives on Routes 9 and 11 and only evolves at 52, so Pawniard does most of the work in the story. Fighting moves hit it 4×, so keep it away from Marshal.

Weavile is very fast with high Attack, and its Ice and Dark moves handle Dragon, Flying, Grass, Ground, Psychic and Ghost types. Sneasel lives in Johto's Ice Path and around Sinnoh's Lake Acuity, and Weavile itself appears in Unova's Dragonspiral Tower and Giant Chasm. Sneasel evolves when it levels up at night holding a Razor Claw.

Unfezant has high Attack and decent Speed, and Pidove is common early in Unova from Route 3 and Pinwheel Forest on. It evolves at 21 and 32, so it stays strong through the middle of the story. Its Flying moves handle Burgh's Bug types and Marshal's Fighting types.
